items.title: Meta spend $52.71 CAD, 1 lead, CPL $52.71 (Flooring Problems Campaign)
items.summary: Yesterday (2026-08-11) Titan spent $52.71 CAD across 1 active campaign, generating 1 lead at a $52.71 CPL. All spend came from 'Flooring Problems Campaign', the only active campaign of 4 — the other 3 are paused.

items.title: CPL ~2.8x 7-day baseline: Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Flooring Problems Campaign spent $52.71 for 1 lead yesterday (CPL $52.71), versus its 7-day baseline CPL of $18.58 across 19 leads/$352.93 spend — roughly 2.8x higher. Window spend clears the $50 minimum for flagging; day-to-day volume is thin (1 lead) so treat as a signal to watch, not yet a budget call.

needs_attention: Flooring Problems Campaign's raw `actions` include lead-like action types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — seen in both yesterday's and the 7-day baseline pull, values matching the counted lead figure both times). Counts weren't affected this run, but the set should be reviewed/extended so a future divergence doesn't silently undercount leads.
